claims.assertion: Anéeka describes the pineal gland as a modulator and interface that translates etheric experiences into conscious memories, rather than receiving the soul signal itself.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the signal enters through the whole brain and body.

claims.assertion: She says pineal rod-like structures produce nerve stimuli interpreted by the brain’s psycho-visual area as images from nonphysical experiences.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says this resembles, but is not, ordinary visual reception.
